# Todo

> A fast, accessible todo list with categories, priorities, search and filters, saved in your browser.

Todo is a one-page app built with React 19 and Vite in plain JavaScript. Tasks never leave the browser: they are kept in localStorage (or IndexedDB), and there is no backend, account, tracking or analytics.

## Features

- Add, edit, complete and delete tasks, with Undo for a deletion
- A category (Work, Personal, Study, Shopping, Health) and a priority (Low, Medium, High) on every task
- Search with highlighted matches, filters by status and category, sorting by newest, oldest or priority; the filters live in the URL
- Light, dark or system theme
- Export and import of a JSON backup
- Works from the keyboard and with a screen reader, built for WCAG 2.2 AA
